Terms.title: Terms and conditions
Terms.description: These terms explain the rules for accessing and using the Automart marketplace and its business portals.
Terms.notice: This page is draft prototype content and should be reviewed by qualified legal counsel before production use.

eligibility.title: Account eligibility
eligibility.content: Automart business accounts are intended for authorised traders, suppliers and platform staff. Account holders must provide accurate information and keep account credentials secure.

businessAccounts.title: Business verification
businessAccounts.content: Automart may request commercial registration, tax information, contact details and proof that the representative is authorised to act for the business.

marketplace.title: Marketplace responsibilities
marketplace.content: Traders and suppliers are responsible for product information, prices, availability, invoices, fulfilment and compliance with applicable Egyptian laws and regulations.

prohibited.title: Prohibited activity
prohibited.content: Users must not submit false information, list counterfeit or unlawful products, interfere with platform security or attempt to access another account without authority.

suspension.title: Account restriction
suspension.content: Automart may temporarily restrict or suspend an account when verification fails, security risks are detected or marketplace rules are materially breached.

contact.title: Questions about these terms
contact.content: Questions about marketplace terms should be sent to the official Automart support or legal contact once those channels are published.

Privacy.title: Privacy notice
Privacy.description: This notice describes the types of information Automart may process and how that information supports marketplace operations.
Privacy.notice: This is draft prototype content. The production privacy notice must reflect the final backend, hosting, analytics, payment and data-retention arrangements.

collected.title: Information collected
collected.content: Information may include representative names, business details, contact information, verification documents, product data, orders, quotations, audit records and security events.

usage.title: How information is used
usage.content: Information may be used to create accounts, verify businesses, operate orders and quotations, prevent fraud, improve compatibility data and provide platform support.

sharing.title: Information sharing
sharing.content: Relevant business and transaction information may be shared between authorised marketplace participants and service providers where required to complete platform operations.

security.title: Security measures
security.content: Automart should use access controls, encrypted connections, secure password handling, audit logging and role-based permissions to protect platform information.

retention.title: Data retention
retention.content: Information should be kept only for the period required for marketplace operations, legal obligations, dispute handling, fraud prevention and security auditing.

rights.title: Access and correction
rights.content: Authorised account representatives may request access to or correction of business and personal information through the official support channel.

Accessibility.title: Accessibility
Accessibility.description: Automart aims to provide a marketplace experience that can be used across devices, languages and different access needs.
Accessibility.notice: Accessibility should be tested continuously against WCAG 2.2 Level AA during development and before production release.

commitment.title: Our commitment
commitment.content: Automart aims to follow recognised accessibility practices and to address barriers that prevent authorised users from completing essential business tasks.

features.title: Interface features
features.content: The interface includes visible focus states, text labels, semantic headings, consistent navigation, responsive layouts, colour contrast and alternatives for important icons.

keyboard.title: Keyboard navigation
keyboard.content: Interactive controls should be reachable and usable with a keyboard, with a logical focus order and no keyboard traps.

language.title: Language and direction
language.content: Automart supports English and Arabic interfaces, including left-to-right and right-to-left layouts.

feedback.title: Accessibility feedback
feedback.content: Accessibility issues should be reported through the official support channel with the affected page, device, browser and assistive technology details.

NotFound.title: This route does not exist
NotFound.description: The address may be incorrect, the page may have moved or the requested feature may not be available yet.
